stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A crack can be damage, but it can also be evidence.”?
options: A used page, even a messy one, can show that learning happened.
Instead, because someone filled the silence with kindness, it became part of the show.
Repair can honor survival instead of pretending nothing happened.
A cleaner future still needs planning, repair, and patience.
